name: Short Fuse
blurb: Innate: Periodically,  Ziggs' next basic attack will deal bonus magic damage, increased against  structures.

effects.description: Innate: Periodically, Ziggs empowers his next basic attack to deal 20 - 184 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) bonus magic damage,[ increased by 75% against structures. ][ increased to 35 - 322 (based on level) (+ 87.5% AP) against structures. ]
Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced by 4 / 5 / 6 (based on level) seconds whenever Ziggs casts an ability.

notes:
The empowered attack will not trigger against  wards.
The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
Short Fuse will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to  blind.
PENDING FOR TEST:: Short Fuse's interactions with  dodging and  blocking effects.
